TX.v1: Baalveer ka ye scene yaad hai? Isme poora Singly Linked List traversal chhupa hai! Dekho, Dooba Dooba chaar ko ek sandesh mila, jo Rani Pari tak pahunchana hai. Yahan Dooba Dooba chaar hai hamara HEAD node, aur sandesh hai uska data.
TX.v2: Ab traversal shuru! Ek pointer lo, temp, jo head pe khada hai. Jab tak temp NULL nahi hota, loop chalta rahega. Har node pe data print karo, aur temp ko next pe bhej do.
TX.v3: Dooba Dooba chaar se teen, teen se do, do se ek... har baar bas next pointer pakdo, aur aage badho. Peeche jaane ka koi raasta nahi, isiliye ye Singly Linked List hai!
TX.v4: Aur Rani Pari hai last node! Uske next mein hai NULL. Temp jaise hi NULL hua, loop ruk gaya, aur sandesh deliver! Har node sirf ek baar visit hua, toh time complexity hai O of N.
TX.v5: Toh ek line mein yaad rakho: Head se shuru, next pakad ke chalo, NULL pe ruk jao! Comment mein batao, agla concept kaunse Baalveer scene se samjhaun? Save karo, share karo, aur pretestpassed dot codes ko follow karna mat bhoolna!
